title: Marketing Artist Intern
desc:
Teknasyon: The Venture OS
is a universe of studios, each with its own orbit, its own speed, and its own ambition. It keeps creating, powers itself, and gets bigger.
Getcontact, eSIM io, Call.io, Telicall, Moyra, Shorten, Slowrush, Rockads, and Zotlo build apps and SaaS platforms for the world, run by people who still work like it's day one.
And it keeps growing. We back bold founders, bring their ideas in, and give them everything it takes to become a studio of their own. Some start with us from day one, others join later. All of them get the same thing: room to move fast, and a universe behind them.
Shared know-how, global ambition. That's how the right ideas scale into global tech companies. Hundreds of products and nearly 5 billion downloads in thirteen years. But the part that matters most is the part you'll never download: the people, the culture, and the years behind it.
This is where "MORE." begins. Join us!
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Support the creation of high-performing static, motion, and short-form video creatives for user acquisition campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Google, and other digital platforms.
Assist in developing creative concepts, adapting existing assets, and producing multiple creative variations to support performance marketing campaigns.
Learn how to create and iterate different hooks, messaging, visual styles, CTAs, formats, and localization variations to improve campaign performance.
Use AI-powered creative tools to accelerate ideation, asset generation, localization, and creative production workflows while finalizing assets using industry-standard design and motion tools.
Support the adaptation of creatives for different languages, audiences, and markets while maintaining brand consistency and delivering a native user experience.
Assist in preparing creative assets by resizing, formatting, editing, and creating platform-specific variations for different campaign needs.
Collaborate with Marketing, Creative, Product, and Growth teams across different ventures to support global product marketing initiatives.
Stay up to date with creative trends, performance marketing best practices, and emerging AI technologies while continuously expanding your creative toolkit.
Contribute ideas during brainstorming sessions and help transform insights into engaging, performance-driven creatives.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
Currently studying or recently graduated in Graphic Design, Visual Communication Design, Digital Media, Advertising, Animation, or a related field.
Passionate about digital advertising, creative production, and designing content that reaches global audiences.
Familiar with Adobe Creative Suite, Photoshop.
Basic knowledge of After Effects is highly preferred.
Curious about AI-powered creative tools and eager to learn how they can enhance creative production workflows.
Interested in performance marketing and excited to understand how creative testing, experimentation, and iteration drive campaign success.
Detail-oriented with a strong visual eye and an interest in crafting engaging user experiences.
Creative, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Comfortable receiving feedback, experimenting with new ideas, and continuously improving your work.
Strong communication skills in English.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE
Grow fast
Build products that reach millions. Explore Marketing, Product, and People Experience, learn from top mentors, and own your work in a startup-minded culture.
Feel good
Unlimited private health insurance for you and your family · Multisport card · massage chairs and gaming zones · daily open buffet breakfast, coffee, fresh juice and snacks.
Enjoy the extras
Netflix, Spotify & YouTube · annual app store credit · Cambly language support · commute & meal allowance · welcome package · brand discounts · referral bonuses.
Belong here
One of Europe's & Turkey's top Great Place to Work–certified companies · hybrid flexibility · above-industry paid leave · social clubs, team events, and the Volunteers Club.
And the legend
Our 4-day Pitstop retreat in Cyprus
